Microsoft Visual C++ .NET 2003 SP1 optimizing compiler, 13.10.6030
================================================================

These eight unmodified binaries are the English x86 compiler and its runtime
dependencies from Microsoft's VS7.1sp1-KB918007-X86.exe. No installer was run.
The original compiler, headers and libraries remain in the Open-BFME-1 submodule.
This optional profile uses those same headers and libraries.

Original Microsoft download URL (404 at retrieval on 2026-10-18):
https://download.microsoft.com/download/b/5/f/b5f05fd6-2509-4a88-b70c-e0b1d1312852/VS7.1sp1-KB918007-X86.exe
Archive mirror used:
https://ftp.zx.net.nz/pub/dev/microsoft-updates/vc71/VS7.1sp1-KB918007-X86.exe
Official release announcement:
https://devblogs.microsoft.com/cppblog/visual-studio-net-2003-service-pack-1-released/

Original update size: 163928456 bytes
SHA1: e8e83d93c690ded045215acaab55947cbf7a4c15
SHA256: 8c8659339772ba01cc67786a9da1d5cf3ba83767e1ce17629d51ab66c22547c4
Windows Get-AuthenticodeSignature: Valid; signer CN=Microsoft Corporation.
The SHA1 agrees with archived Microsoft Download Center metadata.

  msvcp71.dll  FL_msvcp71_dll_____X86.3643236F_FC70_11D3_A536_0090278A1BB8
  msvcr71.dll  FL_msvcr71_dll_____X86.3643236F_FC70_11D3_A536_0090278A1BB8

The CAB also carries a Standard compiler with similarly named members;
its cl_exe_5 and c2_dll_5 files are NOT the optimizing compiler selected here.
Every binary's SHA256 is enforced by tools/compiler_profiles.py on selection
and tracked in compiled-object receipts. The compiler reports 13.10.6030.

Reason for this profile: retail's August 2005 DXErr archive has CodeView
frontend/backend 13.10.4035, rather than the default 13.10.3077. SP1 supports
/hotpatch, which RTM ignores. With /O1 /Oy- /hotpatch, the pristine SDK safe-string
bodies reproduce retail's hotpatch entries and complete function extents.
This does not assert that retail itself was built with SP1.

Use '// compiler: vc71-sp1' in an evidence-backed source only. There is no
automatic compiler search or fallback, and sources without it keep RTM.
